sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE status = 'open' AND application_deadline BETWEEN CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2027-01-31' AS DATE) ORDER BY application_deadline LIMIT 50
